title: This week's weather
instructions: Kısa bir haftalık hava durumu. Günlere dikkat et.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Here's the weather for this week.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Monday and Tuesday are going to be cloudy and cool.

script.speaker: host
script.text: On Wednesday, it's going to rain all day.

script.speaker: host
script.text: From Thursday, it will be sunny and warmer, about twenty-five degrees.

questions.prompt: What will the weather be like on Monday?
questions.feedback: Pazartesi ve salı bulutlu ve serin (cloudy and cool).
questions.evidence: Monday and Tuesday are going to be cloudy and cool.
On Wednesday, it's going to rain all day.

questions.prompt: What temperature will it be from Thursday?
questions.feedback: Perşembeden itibaren yaklaşık yirmi beş derece (twenty-five degrees).
